records.purpose: Stores laboratory examinations related to sexually transmitted infections.
records.scope: Laboratory owns attributed specimen/result/assay records and their revisions. Biomarker names, methods, reference intervals, genomic findings and experimental markers remain source-scoped; no universal reference range or clinical validity is inferred. Source-specific scope: STI Laboratory Registry
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded laboratory artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain method, specimen, time, unit, reference-population and verification context; amended results invalidate downstream interpretations. Genomic and experimental biomarker profiles require separate qualified applicability review.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

Source-specific scope: Pulmonology Laboratory Registry
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded laboratory artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Retain method, specimen, time, unit, reference-population and verification context; amended results invalidate downstream interpretations. Genomic and experimental biomarker profiles require separate qualified applicability review.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded twin artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Require scenario/model/input versions, uncertainty and applicability limits; reject stale or revoked inputs. Prediction errors cannot overwrite clinical records or trigger autonomous prescribing, ventilation or emergency disposition.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Require intended population/use, licensed evidence/model versions, uncertainty, clinician disposition and outcome-specific tests. Organ/embryo selection, mortality, antimicrobial, ventilation, pediatric and vaccine outputs stay blocked from autonomous execution.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.
